about_title: One Arrow. One Kill. No Waste.
about_content: Most businesses are currently being led by 'Dronacharyas' who have grown too comfortable. You are likely paying for an in-house CMO taking a big fat paycheck to sit in meetings, or bleeding money on expensive agencies that deliver flashy creatives with zero business logic. Ekalavya Consulting is the 'Middle Path' for brands that value razor-sharp precision, combining 21 years of executive tier-1 agency discipline with relentless ground execution.
